read.text: Hey, are you still up for dinner on Friday? I was thinking we could try that new ramen place on Mission Street around seven thirty. If you'd rather stay in, I can cook instead, just let me know by Thursday so I can pick up groceries. Also, did you ever get your bike back from the shop? Last time we talked they said it would take two weeks, which seems like forever for a flat tire.

Hi team, quick update on the migration. We finished moving the billing tables last night and everything passed the checks. The one open issue is the reporting job, which is still reading from the old database. I'd like to switch it over on Tuesday morning before the nine o'clock standup. If anyone has concerns about that timing, reply here by end of day Monday and we can push it back.

Things to do this weekend. Pick up the dry cleaning before noon on Saturday. Call the landlord about the leaking faucet in the kitchen. Return the library books, they were due on the fourteenth. Buy a birthday card for Mom and mail it by Monday. And if there's time, clean out the garage so the car actually fits in there again.

Let's meet at the coffee shop at four, actually no, make it five, I have a call that might run long. It's the one on the corner of Oak and Twelfth, across from the bank. If you get there first, grab a table by the window. I'll probably order the usual, a large oat milk latte, so no need to wait for me.

Reminder for myself. The dentist appointment moved to Wednesday, October twenty second at two fifteen in the afternoon. Bring the insurance card, the new one, not the one that expired in August. The office is at four eighteen Harbor Boulevard, suite three hundred. Parking is in the garage behind the building and they validate for two hours.

I looked into the flights. The cheapest option leaves San Francisco at six forty in the morning and lands in Denver at ten fifteen, for two hundred and eighty nine dollars round trip. There's a later one at eleven that's about sixty dollars more. Honestly, I'd pay the extra to not wake up at four in the morning, but it's your call since you're the one driving to the airport.

So the bug turned out to be a race condition in the cache layer. Two requests would come in at the same time, both would miss the cache, and both would try to write the same key. Most of the time that was harmless, but when the second write was slower, it would overwrite fresh data with stale data. The fix is to use a lock around the write, or better, a compare and set.

Thanks so much for the gift, it was really thoughtful. The kids have been playing with the puzzle every night since it arrived, and my youngest finally finished the whole thing yesterday. We should get together soon, maybe the weekend after next? Sarah's been asking when she gets to see her cousins again, and I think a trip to the lake would be perfect if the weather holds.

Can you send me the updated budget spreadsheet when you get a chance? I need the numbers for the third quarter, specifically marketing and travel. The version I have shows travel at forty two thousand, but I think that was before the conference got cancelled. Once I have it, I'll put together the summary for Jennifer and we can review it together on Thursday.

Grocery list. Two dozen eggs, a loaf of sourdough, olive oil, the big bottle. Three avocados, not too ripe. Chicken thighs, about two pounds. Spinach, garlic, and a bag of lemons. Oh, and coffee beans, the dark roast from the place downtown if they have it, otherwise whatever's on sale. We're also out of dish soap and paper towels.

I've been thinking about the job offer, and I'm leaning toward taking it. The salary is about fifteen percent higher, and the commute would drop from an hour to twenty minutes. The main downside is leaving the team right before the product launch, which feels bad. I'm going to talk to my manager tomorrow and see if there's a way to hand things off cleanly over the next three weeks.

Just landed. The flight was delayed about forty minutes because of weather in Chicago, but otherwise fine. I'm grabbing my bag now and then I'll get a rideshare to the hotel, which is maybe twenty five minutes from the airport. Can you text me the address for tomorrow's meeting? I think I deleted the email by accident. Talk soon.
